Title: New memory and compute optimized hardware options in Azure SQL Database

Body.Content:
New memory and compute optimized hardware options in Azure SQL Database
Now in preview, M-series and Fsv2-series are new hardware options in Azure SQL Database specialized for workloads requiring very high compute or memory scale, or very fast CPU speed. M-series hardware is memory optimized for workloads demanding more memory and higher compute limits than any other hardware generation in SQL Database. Fsv2-series hardware is compute optimized to deliver low CPU latency and high clock speed for the most CPU demanding workloads.

Learn more about M-series and Fsv2-series hardware options in Azure SQL Database.
